title: The Season Volume Discount on a Crop Input Purchasing Account
content:
The volume discount a member has earned on a crop input account for the crop year just closed is granted once, after the season has closed, and is written against the last invoice raised on the account in that season. The money it carries is taken off what the member owes on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts, and the member sees it on their next statement against that invoice.

## Booking the discount

The desk books the discount with `grant_season_volume_discount_cc5ed557`, which is a tool the desk holds rather than one the member runs: it is unlocked first and then called once, and one call books a single discount line of the volume kind against the named invoice.

### What the call takes

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | The internal reference number identifying the crop input account the discount is granted on, taken from the crop input account record pulled up for this member before the call | An id |
| `invoice_number` | The number of the invoice the discount line is written against, exactly as it stands on the billing record | The shape IN- followed by seven digits, for instance IN-4410287, with no spaces and no lower-case letters; there is no empty-value form |
| `discount_amount` | The money taken off what the member owes by this discount | USD to 2 decimal places, a positive figure, rounded half away from zero to the cent at the moment of the call; there is no empty-value form and no currency symbol is passed |

### What comes back

A confirmation sentence in plain text, carrying the discount line's own internal reference, the invoice number the discount was written against and the discounted money in USD to two decimal places. That sentence is what indicates the discount has posted to the account; no other acknowledgement follows.
